We need to decide relation between two yes/no questions.

Q1: "A ANEEL deve esclarecer se a geração e a distribuição de energia podem pertencer à mesma empresa?" This asks whether ANEEL should clarify if generation and distribution can belong to same company. It's about regulatory clarification on vertical integration.

Q2: "O modelo atual de concessão das distribuidoras de energia elétrica deve ser preservado nas regras de renovação?" This asks whether the current concession model for distributors should be preserved in renewal rules.

These are different issues: one about clarification of ownership rules (generation+distribution), the other about preserving concession model. Not same question, not opposite. So DIFFERENT.
